snippet.title: 'Card Cultivation' Coming on Steam March 5th
snippet.description:
'Card Cultivation' is a Chinese indie card management game steeped in cultivation mythology, with traditional ink-wash aesthetics and will be released on Steam March 5th.
Steam Link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963600/
